description: MTD(f) finds the minimax score of the root with a series of null-window alpha-beta searches. Each pass asks whether the score reaches a guess, and its answer raises a lower bound or lowers an upper bound; the next guess is the score the pass returned. Once the bounds meet, one search with a window just around the score returns it exactly, with its principal variation. Passes revisit the same positions, so use MTD(f) with a transposition table and a good first guess, such as the score of the last deepening iteration.

papers.authors: Aske Plaat, Jonathan Schaeffer, Wim Pijls, Arie de Bruin
papers.title: Best-first fixed-depth minimax algorithms
